items.title: MECH-074d BLA PE-remap attribution: PE-sigma recalibration SWEEP (retest of 894 over-firing)
items.note: RECALIBRATED-THRESHOLD RETEST of MECH-074d; SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-894 (v3_exq_894_mech074d_bla_remap_attribution_selectivity_20260808T005219Z_v3, FAIL/weakens). Routed from the confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-894_2026-08-08 (/failure-autopsy -> /queue-experiment, same-claim retest; MECH-074d is HELD at provisional pending this run rather than demoted). This driver is 894 with ONE change: the single ON arm at the SD-035 default sigma=1.0 becomes a SWEEP of bla_remap_pe_sigma_threshold over [1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5]; all other machinery (representation DV, matched-baseline per-episode restore, OFF drift control, readiness gate, DV-symmetry scoping) is preserved so the runs are directly comparable and the sigma=1.0 arm internally REPLICATES 894's over-firing FAIL. HYPOTHESIS (from the 894 autopsy): across 894's three seeds fire-fraction and attribution-selectivity are INVERSELY correlated (seed 45 fire 0.41 -> C1/C2 PASS; seeds 42/43 fire 0.59/0.91 -> C1/C2 FAIL; C4 fire<=0.25 fails ALL three), the signature of a gate firing far too often and diluting a genuine signal to chance, NOT an absent attribution mechanism. ROOT CAUSE (reconstructed from 894's recorded PE data): the gate's EMA z-score normaliser (bla.py:483-497, alpha=0.02) is reset to mean=0/std=0.1 every episode by bla.reset(), but the env's harm-PE magnitude is ~0.25-0.32, so at the slow alpha the running mean never catches up within a 60-step episode and pe_z stays > 1.0 for most ticks -> over-firing. Seeds need DIFFERENT sigmas to reach the same fire fraction (different bla-tick counts warm the EMA differently), which is why a single higher sigma cannot land all seeds and a SWEEP is the correct instrument. FAITHFUL TO THE CLAIM: MECH-074d specifies firing at ~1 SD of the RUNNING PE distribution; the per-episode-reset EMA mis-estimates that SD, so a nominal 2.0-2.5 may correspond to a true ~1-SD excursion -- the sweep tests the mechanism at its intended sparsity, not a departure. The deeper EMA/reset fix is a bla.py SUBSTRATE change, OUT OF SCOPE here, recorded as follow-on if the sweep confirms over-firing. DESIGN: 5 arms x 3 seeds [42,43,45] (44 excluded per the standing reef-config early-death instability; same seeds as 894). ARMS: ARM_REMAP_OFF sigma=1e9 (C3 drift control, one per seed) + ARM_SIGMA_10/15/20/25. A high-sigma cell that sparsifies below the readiness floor goes gate-RED and is scoped out for that (seed,arm) without vacating others (V3-EXQ-785 rule, via precondition_gate). COMBINATION_RULE (OR over arms, recorded explicitly per V3-EXQ-846): each ON arm passes iff C1 AND C2 AND C3 AND C4 on >=2/3 green seeds; RUN PASS iff ANY ON sigma arm passes. DIRECTION: supports = some sigma passes; mixed = attribution gate RECOVERS with sparsification (C1 AND C2 met at some sigma, or mean selectivity rises monotonically across the sweep with the top sigma clearing C1) without a full pass; weakens = attribution never recovers (894's FAIL stands). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is C1-C4 as a function of RAISED sigma; the only run tagging MECH-074d with this DV is 894, which tested sigma=1.0 ONLY -- the recalibrated readout is absent from every manifest -> run (not recoverable). RE-DERIVE BRAKE: 0 counted substrate_ceiling autopsies on MECH-074d (the single 894 autopsy is category 'standard', action 'none') -> not braked. SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP GATE: no open substrate_queue entry declares substrate_paths overlapping bla.py/agent.py/e1_deep.py -> clear. ETHICS PREFLIGHT: all-false/allow (V3 harm streams are pre-ethical instrumentation, SENT-0). SMOKE (1 seed, seed 42) PASS: all tier-1 engagement checks green; the sweep is non-degenerate even at smoke scale -- fire fraction falls 0.93/0.83/0.48/0.12 across sigma 1.0/1.5/2.0/2.5 (fire_fraction_varies_across_sweep true, ruling out a saturation fingerprint) and slot differentiation recovers to 0.454 (>OFF baseline 0.089) at sigma 2.5, confirming the predicted partiality recovery; validate_experiments --strict OK, 0 warnings. STEP 8.6: queued from a Mac dev box WITH coordinator.env, so this entry is POSTed to /queue/add (authoritative Phase-3 ingress) after the push lands -- the git commit alone is NOT durable (phase3-queue snapshot writer erased the first 894/895 git-only adds; that is why the POST is mandatory).

items.title: SD-014 node-valence stronger-gain retest (incentive-sensitization rate 0.10 / max 8.0 / coupling 2.5)
items.note: Retest of SD-014 incentive-sensitization decouple (ree-v3 d8a94bd) at a STRONGER gain: rate 0.05->0.10, max 4.0->8.0, coupling 1.0->2.5. Byte-identical instrument to 887/887a. 887a (default gain) was FAIL/weakens but a genuine partial improvement -- seed 2026 cleared both load-bearing criteria (tau 0.835, |Spearman(w,l)| 0.896), seeds 42/137 missed narrowly (tau 0.852-0.863, |Spearman| 0.919-0.925). Autopsy (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-887a_2026-08-08, confirmed) found the clearing seed had the LOWEST raw exposure -> mechanism is drive-level-gated not exposure-count-gated -> stronger gain, not more episodes. Strengthening weighted toward coupling (saturation-safe post-accumulation multiplier); rate/max only 2x to lift the 4.0 ceiling that likely clipped 887a's inter-node g-spread without collapsing into uniform saturation (which C2 would catch as a fresh failure). GOV-REUSE-1: new manipulation (no run carries these gain values), decisive C1/C2/C3 readout not recorded/derivable -> run. Substrate verified on origin/main (update_wanting_sensitized + config knobs; d8a94bd, 32edd553 ancestors). Landed via throwaway worktree off origin/main (shared ree-v3 checkout was 30-behind + dirty).
